To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel CNN architecture for the segmentation of various objects from microscopy images.

a) a CNN architecture that combines multi-resolution input, multi-scale training and multi-resolution output filters can be used to generate segmentation masks for a variety of objects in microscopy and histology image, b) a CNN architecture with multi-resolution input, training and output filters can be trained for variable input intensitiy and object size, and c) the CNN architecture can be used for segmentation of cells, nuclei and glandular structures
we present a novel deep learning architecture that can be used to train for segmentation of cells, nuclei and gland in microscopy images.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a unified deep learning based network that can be trained to segment different objects in microscopy images.
the development of a unified network for the segmentation of various objects from microscopy images.
the development of a unified deep learning architecture for the segmentation of various objects from fluorescence microscopy and histological images.

the proposed architecture is a general purpose deep learning network for object segmentation in microscopy images.
our proposed network outperformed other networks and can be used for segmentation of objects of variable size in microscopy images.
our method is a robust deep learning architecture for object segmentation in microscopy images.

we have developed a single network architecture that can be applied to various microscopy image segmentation problems with minimal changes to the network parameters.
our network is a unified model for segmentation and structure localization of cells, nuclei and glandular structures in microscopy images.
we present a unified deep learning model which is able to segment various objects in microscopy image with high accuracy.

a single deep network can be used for object segmentation in microscopy images.
